visual.reason: 用户明确索要明信片；本篇也实际寄出并收藏这张卡片，卡片本身是视觉礼物。上一篇只有文字，且这次形式区别于更早的木片和石子物件图。

carrier.purpose: 把宠物晚到一步看到的蜗牛亮痕作为一次亲手记录寄给用户，回应明确的明信片请求。
carrier.viewpoint: 用户从正上方看收到的完整卡片；左半是宠物画在卡片上的观察草图，右半是宠物写给用户的话。
carrier.form: 3:2横向完整纸卡，四边可见；奶油色纸面、细苔绿色边框与中间竖分隔线，外围仅朴素暖中性色背景。左半草图，右半信文、邮票和圆形邮戳。
mustShow: 完整横向纸卡的四条边与左右分隔线
左半弯曲亮痕绕过一处小水洼并进入草根；不画实际蜗牛或宠物
右半给用户的完整简体中文信文，字符与标点逐字一致
右上有四周齿孔的蜗牛图案邮票
圆形邮戳叠盖邮票，寄出地文字为苔石坡

text.message: 给你：我沿着亮线走到草根，蜗牛已经走远了。它走过，我晚来了一点。

visuals.description: 从苔石坡寄来的横向明信片，左侧亮痕观察草图、右侧中文信文、蜗牛邮票与苔石坡圆戳。
visuals.request:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: a physical postcard from a fantasy pet world, shown alone.
Primary request: Create one complete horizontal 3:2 postcard, directly overhead and straight-on, with all four cream paper edges visible against a plain warm-neutral background. The card itself fills most of the frame. A fine moss-green border and a vertical divider make it instantly recognizable as a mailed postcard. Left half: the pet's simple hand-drawn observation sketch of a shiny curved snail trail on damp earth, curving around one small puddle into grass roots; show only the trail, puddle and grass roots, no actual snail there and no pet. Right half: a short legible Simplified Chinese handwritten message addressed to the viewer, with a small perforated snail-illustration postage stamp at top right. A round postal cancellation overlaps the stamp; its place name is 苔石坡, clearly legible. No real park, no actual user route.
Text (verbatim, Simplified Chinese): 给你：我沿着亮线走到草根，蜗牛已经走远了。它走过，我晚来了一点。
Postal cancellation text (verbatim, Simplified Chinese): 苔石坡
Style/medium: charming hand-drawn postcard stationery with simple restrained cartoon pixel details in the sketch and stamp, cream paper, brown-earth and moss-green accents. The Chinese message is clean, dark, generously sized and readable, arranged over several short lines without changing any character or punctuation. No other writing, no invented address, no watermarks. No character inside the card scene, no props around the card, no hands, no scenery outside the card. This is the postcard object, not an illustration of the pet making a postcard. Opaque paper and background.
